content:
Great effort on your Warrior One pose! Let's refine a few key points to help you get the most benefit and maintain proper alignment.

First, your spine isn't quite straight. Aim to lengthen your spine by gently lifting through your chest and drawing your shoulders down and back. Imagine a string pulling you up from the crown of your head to create that tall, upright posture.

Next, your arms are not fully extended straight up. Try to actively reach your fingertips toward the ceiling, keeping your arms parallel and strong. This will open your chest more and enhance your balance.

Finally, your front knee is not directly over your ankle. Make sure to align your knee so it stacks right above your ankle to protect your joint and build stability in the pose.

Keep up the great work! With just a bit of mindful adjustment, you'll feel more balanced and strong in Warrior One. Keep breathing deeply and steady. You're doing wonderfully!
